episodes.synopsis: Prince Oscar, heir to the throne of Farsas, was cursed in his childhood - a curse that prevents him from producing an heir. His last chance is the help of the Witch of the Azure Moon, but she lives in a gigantic azure tower that harbors many dangers...
episodes.title: Cursed Words and the Azure Tower

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha has just arrived at Farsas Castle, when she finds that she must set off for the border. There, she confronts her past memories, as well as a foe who has been biding time for seventy years.
episodes.title: The Past Recalled Once Again

episodes.synopsis: Oscar and Lazar venture into a forest to investigate a series of mysterious deaths, out of Tinasha's watchful gaze. Unbeknownst to them, the Witch of the Forbidden Forest awaits within.
episodes.title: What the Forest Dreams Of

episodes.synopsis: A foreign envoy shows up at Farsas Castle, demanding an audience with Tinasha. As Oscar is about to send him away, the mysterious envoy utters a name that changes his mind.
episodes.title: A Breath of Life into Image

episodes.synopsis: The king reveals a new potential bride for Oscar: Miralys, a palace maid. A disgruntled Oscar notices that Tinasha has taken this opportunity to keep her distance from him.
episodes.title: Unnamed Emotion

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha finally succeeds in breaking the curse, thus fulfilling her contract with Oscar. In the middle of the king's birthday celebration, she comes to Oscar with a shocking revelation.
episodes.title: As the Abyss is Born

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha leaves Farsas to defect to Cuscull at Lanak's side. Something about her actions, however, don't quite add up, which does not escape the notice of Cuscull's chief mage.
episodes.title: The End of the Dream

episodes.synopsis: During a visit to a fortress on the border of Farsas, Oscar runs into a band of marauding nomads. Their leader challenges Oscar to a duel, on sacred grounds that hide a dark secret.
episodes.title: Green Vines

episodes.synopsis: The kingdom of Farsas enjoys some much-needed peace as the end of the year approaches. Beneath the tranquility, however, a plot is brewing with Farsas Castle as its target.
episodes.title: The Things Unknown

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha finds out that her tower has some unexpected visitors. Oscar reluctantly prepares to attend a public function in the neighboring nation of Gandona.
episodes.title: Blank Slate Children

episodes.synopsis: Oscar and Tinasha venture out to Yarda to find its missing princess, and to put an end to the escalating civil conflict orchestrated by the Witch Who Cannot Be Summoned.
episodes.title: Castle of Sand

episodes.synopsis: One day, as Oscar is helping Tinasha clean up around the tower, he finds himself mysteriously drawn in by a familiar-looking orb.
episodes.title: Two Joined Memories
